title: Embrace – Embrace health care
text: Scroll to top How can we help? Ask me anything about our services… Community engagement Participate in fulfilling activities within your community. We’re committed to offering creative and individualised assistance, empowering participants to achieve their aspirations, forge relationships, and enhance self-reliance. Our services include Social engagement & community involvement Life brightens up when you’re out and about, sharing moments with others. If you need support to make this happen, we’re here for you. Whether it’s navigating public transport, joining a social club, enrolling in a course, or attending events – we’ve got you covered. We’re here to help you forge new friendships, broaden your social circle, and boost your confidence in social settings. At Embrace, we ensure you to truly relish being part of your community. High intensity support This support service by Embrace, ensures that participants needing High Intensity Supports can fully engage in community, social, and recreational activities, with the help of skilled and experienced support workers. It’s also applicable when participants require aid from disability support workers and registered nurses with specific high intensity support skills outlined in the NDIS Practice Standards. At Embrace, we will take care of our clients, irrespective of their disability or medical condition.
